def bname(s,n):return s.encode('ascii','replace')[:n].ljust(n,b'\x00')
def make_inst(ins):
    # includes exactly one 16-bit mono sample, with sample header followed by delta PCM data
    points, sus=ins.env if ins.env else ([],None)
    volume_pts=b''.join(struct.pack('<HH',x,y) for x,y in points).ljust(48,b'\x00')
    pan_pts=bytes(48)
    envflag=(1+(2 if sus is not None else 0)) if points else 0
    flags=bytes([len(points),0,sus if sus is not None else 0,0,0,0,0,0,envflag,0,*ins.vib])
    assert len(flags)==14
    head=(struct.pack('<I',263)+bname(ins.name,22)+b'\x00'+struct.pack('<H',1)
          +struct.pack('<I',40)+bytes(96)+volume_pts+pan_pts+flags
          +struct.pack('<HH',ins.fade,0)+bytes(20))
    assert len(head)==263, ('insthdr',len(head))
    data=ins.a
    ssize=len(data)*2
    if ins.loop:
        loopt=ins.front*2; loopl=ins.loop*2
        assert ins.front+ins.loop==len(data)
        typ=0x11 # 16-bit forward loop
    else:loopt=loopl=0;typ=0x10
    sh=(struct.pack('<III',ssize,loopt,loopl)+struct.pack('<BbBBbB',ins.volume,0,typ,ins.pan,ins.rel,0)
        +bname(ins.name,22))
    assert len(sh)==40
    # XM 16-bit PCM signed deltas modulo 65536
    d=data.astype(np.int32); delta=np.concatenate((d[:1],d[1:]-d[:-1])).astype('<i2')
    return head+sh+delta.tobytes()

    dat=bytearray()
    for r in range(64):

            v=cells.get((p,r,c),(0,0,0,0,0))
            mask=0x80; used=[]
            for b,x in zip([1,2,4,8,16],v):
                if x:mask|=b;used.append(x)
            dat.extend((mask,*used))
    assert len(dat)<65536
    return struct.pack('<IBHH',9,0,64,len(dat))+dat

def bname(s,n):return s.encode('ascii','replace')[:n].ljust(n,b'\x00')
def make_inst(ins):
    # includes exactly one 16-bit mono sample, with sample header followed by delta PCM data
    points, sus=ins.env if ins.env else ([],None)
    volume_pts=b''.join(struct.pack('<HH',x,y) for x,y in points).ljust(48,b'\x00')
    pan_pts=bytes(48)
    envflag=(1+(2 if sus is not None else 0)) if points else 0
    flags=bytes([len(points),0,sus if sus is not None else 0,0,0,0,0,0,envflag,0,*ins.vib])
    assert len(flags)==14
    head=(struct.pack('<I',263)+bname(ins.name,22)+b'\x00'+struct.pack('<H',1)
          +struct.pack('<I',40)+bytes(96)+volume_pts+pan_pts+flags
          +struct.pack('<HH',ins.fade,0)+bytes(20))
    assert len(head)==263, ('insthdr',len(head))
    data=ins.a
    ssize=len(data)*2
    if ins.loop:
        loopt=ins.front*2; loopl=ins.loop*2
        assert ins.front+ins.loop==len(data)
        typ=0x11 # 16-bit forward loop
    else:loopt=loopl=0;typ=0x10
    sh=(struct.pack('<III',ssize,loopt,loopl)+struct.pack('<BbBBbB',ins.volume,0,typ,ins.pan,ins.rel,0)
        +bname(ins.name,22))
    assert len(sh)==40
    # XM 16-bit PCM signed deltas modulo 65536
    d=data.astype(np.int32); delta=np.concatenate((d[:1],d[1:]-d[:-1])).astype('<i2')
    return head+sh+delta.tobytes()

def make_pattern(p):
    dat=bytearray()
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(CHANNELS):
            v=cells.get((p,r,c),(0,0,0,0,0))
            mask=0x80; used=[]
            for b,x in zip([1,2,4,8,16],v):
                if x:mask|=b;used.append(x)
            dat.extend((mask,*used))
    assert len(dat)<65536
    return struct.pack('<IBHH',9,0,64,len(dat))+dat

def save(path):
    order=bytes(range(n_patterns))+bytes(256-n_patterns)
    hdr=(b'Extended Module: '+bname('PARALLAX / signed light',20)+b'\x1a'
        +bname('FT2 - original sounds',20)+struct.pack('<H',0x0104)
        +struct.pack('<I',276)+struct.pack('<HHHHHHHH',n_patterns,2,CHANNELS,n_patterns,
                                            len(instruments)-1,1,6,148)+order)
    assert len(hdr)==336,len(hdr)
    out=hdr+b''.join(make_pattern(i) for i in range(n_patterns))+b''.join(make_inst(a) for a in instruments[1:])
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),exist_ok=True)
    with open(path,'wb') as f:f.write(out)
    print(f'XM {path} bytes={len(out)} patterns={n_patterns} instruments={len(instruments)-1} events={len(cells)}')
